read.sentence: A black loudspeaker cabinet with a framed screen or mirror on top stands in the middle of a wet elevated highway at dusk, while behind it on the left a car burns with tall orange flames and thick black smoke, and a tall concrete tower block rises on the right.
read.dark_mass: thick plumes of black smoke rising from the burning car, lit orange from below
read.fire: an old sedan burning, two smaller fires nearby

tells: the fire a soft creamy glow with no tongues, rising behind the car not out of it
the car placeholder-grade: flat sides, wire-thin pillars, puck wheels
the smoke mushy, soft-edged, no sky light on the tops; the firelight a smooth orange haze
the flames an airbrushed cone, standing like a wall behind the car
the car a low-detail slab; no dark reflection of it in the wet road
the smoke even, same-sized cotton-ball puffs; the fire-lit base a smooth orange haze
realism.most_convincing: the setting and grade; the product dark and backlit, warm fire light on its left edges, cool sky on its right

note: p4 preferred 3 of 4 (+0.75 in the duel) though the realism critics scored it 4.5 against p3's 5.0; the car now reads as a sedan
